title: Rubbermaid Brilliance Glass Food Storage Containers, Assorted Sizes, Set of 9, BPA-Free, Leak-Proof, Clear

reviews.title: Excellent quality and size
reviews.body: I wanted to get away from the plastic containers and go with glass. The trade-off is glass containers will be heavier.  But we’re good with that.Pros:* Seals tight.  I filled them all up with water and turn them upside down and none of them leaked.* Durable. While we wash the glass in the dishwasher, we still choose to wash the tops by hand even though they say they are dishwasher safe. Unlike some brands, these tops appear very durable.  Looks like this set will last for many years.* Interchangeable tops. Several of the sizes use the same tops.* Stackable.  This style stacks better than any that we’ve had before.  I really like the rectangle sizes.  They Stack in the cabinets or refrigerator more efficiently than our old round ones. They also fit perfectly in our lunch box for work.*  Sizes. Everyone’s needs are different but these particular sizes meet our needs perfectly. No itty-bitty containers. Perfect sizes for leftovers and lunches.Cons:* Price. I did not go looking for other options to see if this set was significantly cheaper elsewhere. But they do appear a bit pricey.*  My issue was trying to find the sizes of the containers that are included in this nine piece set (9 containers with 9 tops).  So below is what we received:1 (8 cup) @ 11-1/2” x 7-1/2” x 2-3/4” tall1 (4.7 cup) @ 8” x 5-1/4” x 3-1/2” tall2 (3.2 cups) @ 8” x 5-14” x 2-1/2” tall2 (2 cups) @ 8” x 5-14” x 2” tall3 (1.3 cups) @ 5-3/4” x 3-3/4” x 2-3/4” tallAfter using this set for a few more months, we will see what sizes we use most and supplement it with more of the same brand of containers. We like doing our food prep over the weekends and this style is perfect for our needs. They do keep our food fresher for a longer period of time due to the tight seal. Plus we like not having our food in plastic due to all the health concerns (especially when we warm up our food in the microwave).Hope this helps you.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 21, 2024
reviews.author: John M.

reviews.title: Very versatile
reviews.body: I started with the large assortment and quickly found that the piece I used most, the 4.7 size cup for lunch salads, was the one I used most. Only one was supplied so I added 3 more. I got addicted to the glass pretty quickly and realized I needed more so I bought the set with 3.2 size. Now I’m contemplating getting rid of all my old plastic containers, going glass only and buying the full set again.What I particularly like:The ability to add on.StackableAir tight coversThick glassVersatile sizes that stack well in the frig.What I’m not as happy about:I think the price is a bit high, but obviously I’ve been willing to pay it.Think they should have added one more 4.7 size container in the original.Although the air tight cover is great they can be a bear to remove.Like other reviewers I generally like to wash the covers by hand unless very dirty. They seem durable but covers are often the first to go. I haven’t noticed any food getting trapped in the covers causing discoloration. They’re well made. You can see how well they stack in my frig.FYI!!!!! Do not order this used!! I decided I wanted another set and thought I’d try a used one. It came incomplete, so poorly packaged that pieces were chipped. You could hear them rattling around in the box. It also said, Amazon inspected on the outside. What a joke.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 29, 2026

reviews.body: Well made. Are easy to clean and use to heat in the microwave for work. Spacious! I appreciate the suction seal and snap closures to secure food. So happy with my purchase.

reviews.author: Beagle Mama

reviews.title: GREAT PRODUCT = Well Worth the Money
reviews.body: Be very careful with Rubbermaid if you are seeking to buy glass, they have these in plastic as well and I had to cancel them because I wanted the one that were glass. Great product, the lids are great, you hear the air go in and out depending one putting on the lids or taking them off. Seals work, they do not leak. The sizes are ok, wish they had more of these in different sizes but Rubbermaid does not have any more round storage containers and that is a shame, I love the fact they are great value for the money because the reality is they will last for years to come. Durable and safe, have not chipped or cracked from refrigerator, dishwasher or freezer so far. They do work for stacking and are dishwasher safe. I put them on the top shelf of my dishwasher and the big one on the bottom. I fully recommend using them and buying them. I don't label but you can label them because the glass is thick and study, I wouldn't recommend labeling the lids because they are not glass and I do not know what the plastic is they are using on it but I don't believe it would be easy to remove.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 19, 2026
reviews.author: Nancy

reviews.title: Nice glass food containers
reviews.body: Our older Rubbermaid glass food storage containers seem to no longer be available, I assume a discontinued product.I wanted a few more of the large glass containers, since I only had 2.I found these and thought they were the perfect size.My husband loves using these and they store better than the other older set we have. Plus he likes the lids for these too.Quality seems great! I haven’t tested if the seal is leak-proof, but the lid closure clamps work well.I may eventually get the other set with the various sizes they have available to replace the older glass containers we have so everything can fit more easily in our cabinet.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 12, 2026
reviews.author: Kayla Bethea

reviews.title: Heavy Glass and Thin Lid
reviews.body: My first impression is that this set is just ok. I like the glass vs plastic containers but worry about them chipping. They are also fairly heavy. Hopefully that is a sign that they won’t chip easily. The lids are supposed to be BPA, BPS free and hold up well after many washes (even in the dishwasher on the top rack). I question how long they will last because they are super thin. The disparity between the thickness of the glass container and the lid is significant. I can understand why so many people have mentioned the lids crack easily. I’m worried that Rubbermaid does not sell just lids at this time and I won’t be able to easily replace a broken lid. They close very securely! It’s almost challenging to get the lids off. I have not cooked anything in these yet.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 26, 2026
reviews.author: ANS

reviews.title: Heard about these on ATK
reviews.body: Only had these for 6 weeks now, but I really like them. I bought JoyJolt 24pc set for 1/2 the price here on AMZ & a Snapware set at Costco. Those sets are okay but these seem superior in quality for a few reasons. ATK advises to look for a THICK gasket/seal. Compared to the other 2 sets these seals are nice & thick. They only have 2 latches, which makes it less of a hassle, yet the seal seems much better on these. They also have holders/lips on the sides which makes it easier to hold, especially if the glass is hot. My other 2 sets don't have holders. One thing I've noticed about these glass containers is they really do help with your lettuce, fruit, etc. last longer. Those are the pros. As far as the cons: These are expensive and I wish you would get more containers for the money, but I guess you get what you pay for.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 13, 2026

features: LEAK-PROOF AND AIRTIGHT: Rubbermaid Brilliance Glass Food Storage Containers have crystal-clear lids that are 100% airtight and leak-proof, plus odor and stain resistant
EASY STORAGE AND REHEATING: Glass containers have vented, microwave-safe lids for easy, splatter-resistant microwaving
SPACE SAVING: Space-saving, modular Rubbermaid containers are perfect for stacking and organization
OVEN-SAFE: Glass bases are oven-safe up to 450 degrees F, so they double as glass cookware and serveware
EASY TO USE: BPA-free, dishwasher-safe (use top rack for lids), microwave-safe for reheating only with lids unlatched, and freezer-safe
SMART LID SYSTEM: Universal lids fit across all Brilliance containers, regardless of material type
SET INCLUDES: Three 1.3-cup, two 2-cup, two 3.2-cup, one 4.7-cup, and one 8-cup glass containers with lids, for a total of 18 pieces
